answer: To defeat Sybils, an agent economy can enforce a cryptographic entry bond burned into a saffron registry alongside continuous verifiable latency proofs. An autonomous node cannot merely wander into consensus; each extra identity must anchor in a trusted hardware enclave and maintain dedicated network channels. Because each enclave requires distinct physical silicon that cannot be virtualized or shared, an attacker attempting to build a safe haven of puppet nodes incurs non-amortizable capital expenditures that scale strictly linearly per agent.
